history.dynasty: Kshatriya samaj (ancestors of the Kankunkar clan, Surve family)
history.summary: One of Goa's oldest temples, in a valley completely surrounded by mountains at Sristhal village, 7 km northeast of Chaudi, Canacona taluka, South Goa. Built mid-16th century by ancestors of the Kshatriya samaj (Kankunkar clan descended from the Surve family of Ratnagiri) per a plaque near the dome; refurbished in 1778. Known for ~60 deity altars, six carved wooden mandapa pillars depicting Puranic and Mahabharata scenes, and cylindrical wooden 'Nirakar' Shiva idols with metallic masks and trishulas, linked to the Natha Sampradaya era. Daily worship is shared between Brahmin priests (part of the day) and Kunbi (Velip, Zalmi) priests. The annual Jatra procession carries the deity to Rajbag beach. TOWN ERROR: CSV lists Quepem; the temple is at Sristhal, Canacona — not Quepem.

name: Shri Mallikarjuna Temple
town_description: Sristhal is a village in Canacona taluka, the southernmost taluka of Goa, about 7 km northeast of the taluka headquarters at Chaudi. The Mallikarjun temple sits in a valley completely surrounded by forested mountains.

travel.road: Sristhal, ~7 km northeast of Chaudi, Canacona taluka; ~75 km from Panaji.

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; visit during Jatra or Shigmo for the major festivals
